description: Defines the ResourceType class for managing JSON:API resource type metadata in Drupal, including properties, getters, relationship handling, and path generation.

classes.name: ResourceType
classes.description: Represents metadata for a JSON:API resource type, including properties for entity type, bundle, fields, relationships, and methods for accessing and manipulating this metadata.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the resource type name.

methods.name: getBundle
methods.description: Returns the bundle ID.

methods.name: getDeserializationTargetClass
methods.description: Returns the class to which payloads are deserialized.

methods.name: getPublicName
methods.description: Translates an internal entity field name to its public name.

methods.name: getInternalName
methods.description: Translates a public field name to its internal entity name.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of attribute and relationship fields.

methods.name: getFieldByPublicName
methods.description: Retrieves a field object by its public name.

methods.name: getFieldByInternalName
methods.description: Retrieves a field object by its internal name.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if a field exists by internal name.

methods.name: isFieldEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a field is enabled.

methods.name: includeCount
methods.description: Determines whether to include a collection count; defaults to false.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Checks if the resource type is internal.

methods.name: isLocatable
methods.description: Checks if the resource type's resources are locatable.

methods.name: isMutable
methods.description: Checks if the resource type's resources are mutable.

methods.name: isVersionable
methods.description: Checks if the resource type's resources are versionable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ResourceType object with entity type, bundle, class, flags, fields, and optional type name.

methods.name: setRelatableResourceTypes
methods.description: Sets resource types that can be related via specific fields.

methods.name: getRelatableResourceTypes
methods.description: Returns all resource types that can be related, keyed by relationship field names.

methods.name: getRelatableResourceTypesByField
methods.description: Returns relatable resource types for a specific field.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the URL path for accessing this resource type, replacing '--' with '/'.
